items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Repaint the first image as a finished square illustration for 法师锦囊.
Image 1 controls composition and action: Baita seated and leaning/turning slightly, face upper-left, one held dark-green pouch at left-middle, one hand selecting a folded spell leaf, gold magical paper unfurling diagonally toward the right, flowing brown hair and green skirt below. Image 2 controls Baita's identity ONLY: young adult woman, gentle calm anime face, clear GREEN eyes, long dark brown wavy hair, side-swept bangs kept away from eyes and two simple gold hair clips, white long-sleeved high-collar blouse and forest-green suspender dress with wide straps/gold buckles. Do not copy cake, fork, floating books or sitting furniture from identity reference. Image 3 惩击 supplies PAINTING STYLE ONLY: broad opaque matte masses, purposeful directional swipes, hard-edged grouped shadows, selective face/hand detail; no borrowed character or beam.
Keep exactly ONE cloth spell pouch in the supporting hand. Selecting hand's thumb/index finger grip one ivory-gold folded spell leaf visibly emerging from the pouch; exactly TWO smaller folded leaves remain tucked within it. The selected leaf extends rightward as one broad curling gold-ivory paper-like magical shape, a few principal turns rather than many tiny angular facets. Every gold extension originates from the selected leaf at the pouch, no disconnected magic, duplicate bags or floating unrelated cards. Hands connected naturally to sleeves and arms. Preserve graceful seated pose, gently attentive expression, dark-green dress and brown flowing hair.
REPLACE ALL white backdrop and white empty spaces with a deep muted INDIGO BLUE to GRAY-VIOLET abstract backdrop covering the WHOLE canvas. Broad overlapping color masses with a restrained gradient, slightly lighter muted violet behind the face and bag, darker indigo behind golden spell shape. It must read as a colored painted background, not white, off-white, cream or a white vignette. No room or landscape. Keep warm ivory blouse distinct from the cool dark backdrop. No white border or untouched blank corners.
Repaint hair in a few substantial coherent wavy dark-brown locks, with wide curved swipes, quiet deep-brown regions and a few broad warm shadow/highlight turns. Merge the small ringlets and strand networks from the original into larger wave groups. Fabric follows shoulders, elbow, waist and knee with principal broad fold planes; several long opaque swipes and sparse colored structural accents, large calm cloth regions between folds. Matte opaque loaded-brush color blocks with decisive handmade edges, selectively broken endings and broad overlaps; hard grouped light/shadow with restrained midtone turns. Face/green eyes, important fingertips and pouch opening selectively clear. Economical nose/mouth and anime proportions, clean cheek planes, fringe shadow and neck turn. Gold accessories and paper have few purposeful highlights, not filigree or glitter. No all-over fine brush texture, triangular mosaic, fine hair strands, dense wrinkle lines, polished glossy skin, smooth 3D, noise/grain filter or elaborate magical diagrams. No text, symbols, frame, watermark or UI.
